name: Billowswat
description: Snaps the wrist at the release so the net leaves the hand already open and flying flat.

name: Rough Spread
description: Swings the weighted rim in a short arc that cracks against the opponent's ribs.

name: Meshlinen
description: Tracks the net's climb and fall with the eyes and a trace of qi to time the follow-up step.

name: Slinking Enmesh
description: Closes two paces behind the cast so the opponent has no room to shake the mesh loose.

name: Knotwork Barrier
description: Feeds qi along the cords to keep the spread mesh taut and clinging while the opponent twists inside it.

name: Weavehasp
description: Flares the net rim with qi at the last instant so an incoming strike bounces off the stiffened edge.

name: Mesh Scorer
description: Tosses the net low and short so it bunches around the feet and starts the tangle.

name: Burdening Billow
description: Pulls the cord hand over hand to draw a netted opponent steadily off their stance.

name: Fierce Drawcord
description: Scrapes the dragged hem up the opponent's shin with the leaded edge leading.

name: Padded Leadedge
description: Braces the net-wrapped forearm against the chest to absorb a shoving blow.

name: Haulin Stalk
description: Takes up slack in the cord with each backward step so the tangle never loosens.

name: Smother Barrier
description: Jerks the mesh sideways under the opponent's planted foot to sweep it from beneath them.

name: Binding Meshgrid
description: Roots a thread of qi through the heels and the cord so a hauled opponent cannot drag the thrower in.

name: Weave Carapace
description: Turns a seized net's pull into a twist that tears loose the opponent's grip and spins them away.

name: Rallying Floatrope
description: Measures the long seine against the ground and the target's distance before the throw is committed.

name: Meshswat
description: Sweeps the heavy seine around the body in a wide arc so it lands across several foes.

name: Enmeshslap
description: Drags the lead line across the opponent's thigh in a quick sawing pull.

name: Coasting Smother
description: Shuffles forward in low even steps as if wading so the seine trails without catching.

name: Billowhasp
description: Draws both seine ends toward each other so the encircled opponents are pressed together.

name: Shielding Loopmesh
description: Lifts the weighted seine with qi into a hanging curtain that catches arrows and bolts.

name: Rough Leadedge
description: Surges qi into the lead weights so the heavy net carries far past its usual reach.

name: Meshbandage
description: Fixes the eyes on the runner's hips to read which way the next stride will break.

name: Meshflog
description: Throws the net on the move aimed ahead of the runner so it meets them mid-stride.

name: Clay Billow
description: Flicks the leaded hem at the back of a fleeing opponent's knee as they pull away.

name: Gallhaulin
description: Snaps a cord low across the runner's path so the front foot catches and the stride breaks.

name: Coasting Drawcord
description: Weaves between obstacles in zigzag steps while keeping the net clear of every snag.

name: Brass Hemcord
description: Rolls the net into a tight bundle and braces it before the chest to stop a charging shoulder.

name: Enmesh Flog
description: Casts to where the runner's next foot will fall so the mesh meets the stride instead of chasing it.

name: Clutching Spread
description: Drags a snared runner through a wide curve with qi on the tether so they cannot choose their direction.

name: Weighty Sinker
description: Hurls the net upward to pull a leaping opponent down mid-air before they can land on their feet.

name: Alert Floatrope
description: Rolls the closing cord against the calloused fingers to learn exactly how much pull it will bear.

name: Drapethwack
description: Skims the net along the ground from an underarm swing so it rises and clasps at the knees.

name: Honed Drape
description: Cracks the loose cord end like a whip against the opponent's exposed hand or ear.

name: Splicespread
description: Draws the slip knot closed with a single pull so the loop bites on an ankle or wrist.

name: Armored Meshgrid
description: Holds the ringed net out in a closed circle to stop a thrust against the cords.

name: Grit Weave
description: Slides on the outer edge of the foot to change line without lifting the heel or shaking the cord.

name: Meshhasp
description: Whirls the leaded hem in a flat circle to bat a blade or a stick away.

name: Stampdrape
description: Floods the closing cord with qi so the net mouth clamps a limb with a force no muscle could match.

name: Gallsinker
description: Meets a bull-rush with a sharp backward pull that sets the net hard against the opponent's knees.

name: Rillmesh
description: Releases the slip knot at the instant of capture so the thrower leaps clear while the net keeps the foe.

name: Kindly Sinker
description: Threads a finger through the fine gill mesh to find the barb knots and judge how they will bite.

name: Lurching Haulin
description: Throws the narrow-mouthed net in a tight spin so it drops over the head and arms together.

name: Honed Loopmesh
description: Rakes the barbed knots across the opponent's forearm to scratch and sting.

name: Sleet Mesh
description: Drags the fine mesh slowly across clothing so the barbs catch and hold.

name: Rill Drape
description: Steps sideways along a hedge or fence line so the mesh stays hidden against the leaves.

name: Stamp Knotwork
description: Draws the fine gill mesh across the opponent's moving arms so every struggle sets the knots deeper.

name: Levering Drawcord
description: Flicks the nearly invisible mesh across the face so the opponent loses sight of the thrower's hands.

name: Gap Meshgrid
description: Splits the grip between the staff and the cord and finds how far apart the hands may stand.

name: Weaveslap
description: Lofts a net on the staff tip over a ditch or low wall to drop it on a distant target.

name: Ember Enmesh
description: Jabs the staff butt into the opponent's belly while the net hand holds the cord.

name: Haulinscreen
description: Hooks the net's rim on the staff and pulls to drag an opponent's limb out of line.

name: Brasssinker
description: Plants the staff upright in the ground with the net draped across it as a screen.

name: Brawn Mesh
description: Vaults a short gap on the planted staff and lands with the net already gathered.

name: Purpose Drape
description: Presses the staff across the netted opponent and bears down with qi to pin them against the ground.

name: Rill Loopmesh
description: Whirls staff and net together in one wide sweep that clears thrown knives and spears.

name: Lunar Knotwork
description: Lifts the pleated stack from the belt and feels that every fold lies in order before the throw.

name: Floatrope Flog
description: Throws the pleated stack straight so the folds fall open one after another toward the target.

name: Ember Haulin
description: Flicks a weighted corner of the stack into the opponent's face before the net is thrown.

name: Draught Leadedge
description: Fends off a short cut with the thick folded stack held like a padded buckler.

name: Tethering Hemcord
description: Throws the stack so qi shakes the folds loose in flight and it blooms over the target at the last moment.

name: Draught Spread
description: Snaps the final pleat free as the thrower leaps back so the net blocks the opponent's pursuit.
